propositions: Flaky or intermittently failing tests are bugs requiring root-cause debugging via the /rebar-debug workflow, not CI recheck cycles.
The recheck comment is legitimate only for provably environmental faults (cert expiry, missing CI dispatch, runner outage) with the environmental reason explicitly stated.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently contain contradictory guidance that permits retrying nondeterministic test failures until they pass, which wastes tokens and erodes CI trust.
Guidance must be consolidated in AGENTS.md as the authoritative agent rule and reconciled in CONTRIBUTING.md section 6 to split environmental faults from test nondeterminism into opposite remedies.
A test pinning the new rule and the absence of the old retry-until-green licence must verify both the presence of load-bearing phrases and the contradiction is gone.
